transcript.text: Good morning Sarah Johnson, how have the headaches been since we increased the lisinopril?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: The headaches are much better since the higher lisinopril dose.

transcript.speaker: doctor
transcript.text: Any dizziness or cough?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No dizziness and no cough.

transcript.speaker: doctor
transcript.text: Blood pressure today is 128 over 82, improved from last visit.

transcript.speaker: doctor
transcript.text: Your hypertension is improving, so continue lisinopril 20 milligrams and recheck blood pressure in four weeks.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Sounds good, you can reach me at 555-123-4567.

transcript.text: Robert Wilson, tell me about the lower back pain.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: The lower back pain started three days ago after lifting boxes.

transcript.speaker: doctor
transcript.text: Does the pain go down your leg?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, the pain stays in my lower back and does not go down the leg.

transcript.speaker: doctor
transcript.text: Your straight leg raise test is negative and strength is normal.

transcript.speaker: doctor
transcript.text: This looks like a mechanical lower back strain, so use ibuprofen and stay active.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks, my phone is 555-987-6543.
